messages:
sam_support: FinBank reports a large batch of /api/pay requests show up in access logs but Trace View has no spans. They include their SDK-generated Correlation IDs in the header but stitching fails.

julia_csm: Repro steps attached in the ticket. They can reproduce with long correlation ids (>=90 chars). Short ids show up fine. Ticket FIN-2042.

maria_sre: tagging @ken_infra and @ingest-bot. Any recent changes to edge gateway or header handling that could alter header length/values? :thinking_face:

ken_infra: we rolled edge-gw v3 last week (mostly for TLS perf). There's a new HPACK/header-clamp setting that caps header value length to 64 and slices the rest. I didn't realize it would silently truncate.

ingest-bot: rollout-note: edge-gw v3 deployed to 20% traffic 2024-11-05 03:10 UTC. feature: gw-header-clamp:64 active on those nodes.

sam_support: Customer provided example pair:
```
Client sent: X-Correlation-Id: 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j-abcdef1234567890-EXTREMELY-LONG-SEGMENT-0001
Our access log: X-Correlation-Id: 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j-abcdef1234567890-EXTREMELY-LONG-SEG
```
They match headers exactly to stitch, so truncation breaks the join.

maria_sre: that explains it. Stitcher looks up the literal header string we indexed at ingest time. If the gateway truncates upstream, the value we index won't equal the client's full id.

ken_infra: quick local repro:
```
# simulate long header through edge-gw v3 canary
curl -H "X-Correlation-Id: long-long-long-...-segment" https://ingest-usw.redwood/collect -v
# backend sees truncated value (64 chars)
```
Confirmed the clamp.

rachel_devex: some customers append path+env+uuid into the id (that's why they get long ids). Could we recommend a shorter generator? But we need platform side fix too.

maria_sre: mitigation: disable gw-header-clamp on canary nodes and pause further v3 rollout. ken, can you flip the clamp off for affected pools? We'll also add tests to detect header truncation.

ken_infra: flipping gw-header-clamp off for canary now (03:22 UTC). Opening PR to remove silent-truncate behavior; instead edge-gw will reject overly long header with 400 and log for visibility. Also adding a small fix in ingest path: record a header-length metric and tag suspicious truncation events.

ingest-bot: deploy note: gw-header-clamp disabled in us-west canary 03:23 UTC. metric trace.stitch.misses/us-west shows small improvement.

sam_support: FinBank asks if historic missing spans in the 03:10-03:22 window can be restored. They want to know whether we can re-stitch.

ken_infra: recovery options: if our raw edge logs (pre-truncate) are available we can re-ingest the original header values and re-run stitch for that window. If only truncated values exist, we can attempt heuristic re-stitch: match by prefix+timestamp+path and run a confidence-based reconciliation. I'll schedule a re-stitch job to run after we have the safer ingest path.

maria_sre: postmortem items: add pipeline test that sends long headers and verifies no silent truncation, update release notes to call out header-length behaviour, and add an alert when header-length distribution shifts.

julia_csm: passing recovery plan and timeline to FinBank. They want a console note for the impacted window and confirmation when re-stitch completes.

sam_support: action items recap:
- ken_infra: PR to remove clamp + metric tagging + schedule re-stitch job for 03:10-03:22 window
- maria_sre: add regression tests and alerts, validate canary before global rollout
- julia_csm/sam_support: customer comms + console banner

sam_support: leaving thread pinned to ticket FIN-2042. Re-open here for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
